text: {Name}, a radio repairer from {Place}, joined a resistance transmitter crew after fighting destroyed the shop. The repairer maintained equipment and hoped to host music programmes someday.
self_review: A radio repairer loses a shop in fighting, maintains a resistance transmitter, and hopes to host music programmes.
source_pattern: The supplied Komski testimony describes existing artistic skill being used to produce underground information; Strobos also describes transporting a transmitter.
fictional_changes: Radio repair, the destroyed shop, transmitter work, and music ambitions are fictional. The shared historical pattern is reuse of an existing skill.
